title: AI Design Vault stack profile
description: Describes the host project so the kit's rules, skills and verify script apply to it. Written by /adapt.

adapted.description: false until /adapt has run. The SessionStart hook checks this.

adaptedAt.description: ISO date of the last /adapt run.

id.description: Canonical id. Known: nextjs, react-router, remix, tanstack-start, vite-react, astro, nuxt, vue-vite, sveltekit, svelte-vite, solid-start, qwik, angular, eleventy, hugo, vanilla. Anything else is allowed — record it and describe it in notes.

renderModel.description: How the framework renders. Drives the server-first rule and the SEO/crawlability checks.

paths.description: All paths are repo-relative, no leading ./ and no trailing slash. Null means the concept does not exist in this stack.

source.description: Root of application code, e.g. src or app.

routes.description: Where route/page files live, e.g. src/app, src/routes, src/pages.

views.description: Page-level components routes delegate to. Create it if the stack has no equivalent.

styles.description: The single file holding design tokens.

assets.description: Site content assets, one folder per section.

staticRoot.description: Served-as-is root, e.g. public or static. Favicons/OG/manifest live here.

server.description: Server-side endpoints, e.g. src/app/api, src/routes/api, server/api.

env.description: The single validated env accessor module.

protected.description: Glob paths treated as a vendored engine — verify.sh FAILs on any diff here.

routeEntryGlob.description: Filename patterns identifying a route entry file inside paths.routes, used by the route-delegation check. Defaults cover page.*/+page.*/index.astro. Frameworks where any file is a route need the broad form: Astro ["*.astro"], Nuxt ["*.vue"]. Files under components/, layouts/ or an underscore-prefixed folder are always excluded.

bindings.description: The concrete package or API this project uses for each capability. Rules and skills read these instead of naming a framework.

textMotion.description: Text-animation package, or 'recipe' when the stack has none and the split+stagger recipe is used.

image.description: Image component/import, or 'native' when the stack has none.

link.description: Client-side link component, or 'native' for plain <a>.

metadata.description: How head/meta is produced, e.g. next-metadata, svelte-head, nuxt-useHead, astro-head, react-helmet, manual.

envPublicPrefix.description: Prefix that exposes a variable to the browser, e.g. NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, PUBLIC_, NUXT_PUBLIC_. Anything without it is server-only.

capabilities.description: What the framework can do. Checks that do not apply are skipped rather than failed.

conventions.description: Kit conventions that can be switched off when the host project genuinely conflicts. Turning one off needs an ADR.

commands.description: Verbatim shell commands, package-manager included. verify.sh and every skill run these instead of guessing.

notes.description: Anything a later agent must know that the fields cannot express — a non-standard layout, a deliberate deviation, a framework quirk found during /adapt.
